Hey folks-

I just want to check my logic. So Minion A strikes with First Strike with a
Weapon (Banshee Ironwail), opposing minion B strikes with Blood Fury (THA).
Now, because of Minion A's first strike resolves before the "weapon does no
damage" from Blood Fury resolves then the 3 damage happens. The result is
that B takes 3 from Ironwail and A takes 2 from Blood Fury.

Right?

Tobin
-tpl
